name: io.github.GoogleCloudPlatform/cxidk
title: Conversational Insights DevKit (cxidk)
description: Google Cloud Conversational Insights (CCAI) MCP server for analytics, conversion, and config ops.

environmentVariables.name: CXIDK_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default Google Cloud project ID for CCAI Insights operations.

environmentVariables.name: CXIDK_LOCATION
environmentVariables.description: Default CCAI Insights regional location (e.g. us-central1, europe-west1, global).

environmentVariables.name: CXIDK_ALLOWED_PROJECTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of GCP project IDs permitted for tool calls.

environmentVariables.name: CXIDK_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to expose guarded write tools (config promotion, ingestion, bulk analyze).
